name: @playform/client-dsh-workspace-live
description: The workspace family's live client: the client half of the workspace live view (Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/LIVE.md). The role: the presentation, stable-until-event - the live view does NOT re-render continuously; it stays stable until a workspace event or a D5 trace envelope surfaces a change, and it presents at the END of the invisible flow (... -> the audit lines -> the live view presents). It presents the workspace's REPRESENTATIONS of the Entity/Presentation/Interaction model, never a running OS process (the OS execution axis stays orthogonal). The client half provides the workspaceLive service (snapshot/subscribe/ingest/refresh), mounts the conversation.view tab workspace-live, and consumes the D5 trace (ctx.get("trace"): observe/stamp, graph/indexed, graph/invalidated, and the batch transitions when present) as its live source - the recent envelopes NEWEST FIRST, bounded by maxEvents, rendered as <kind> <path>; a missing trace is the documented static state. When the panel family is composed (playformFamilyPanel present) the tab adopts the v4.1 child-slot model: it declares workspace.live.section in its children table, renders it through renderSlot, and registers the live section into it with the inject face { section, ports } as the data path. Self-contained PoC: the sibling workspace services (workspaceGraph, workspaceObserve, the workspace events) are declared locally in Source/Interface/Siblings.ts from the W1 frozen contract (Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/WAVE-1-BRIEF.md sections 4-5) - no runtime import of sibling packages exists yet; the end-phase wires the real imports.
